name: Leaky Webinar Cover
headline: Why most coaching webinars leak buyers (and how to plug them)
body: Big bold title slide. No bullets. Just the hook and your name.
visual: Cracked bucket dripping leads on a dark background. Title in white. Your name + photo bottom-right.

name: The 4-Day Decay
headline: Most webinars lose 70% of buyers in the first 4 days
body: Show the decay curve. Day 1 to Day 7. Most coaches never run a replay sequence — so the buyers who weren't ready on day one just... vanish.
visual: Line chart sloping down hard from Day 1 to Day 7. Annotate the gap between Day 2 and Day 7 as the 'ghost zone.'

name: What If You Could Plug The Leak
headline: A webinar that keeps selling for 14 days, not 90 minutes
body:
Three things change everything:
• Replays that re-pitch (not just re-air)
• DMs that wake up cold leads
• Email sequences tied to behavior, not time
visual: Clean three-icon row across the slide. One icon per bullet. Generous whitespace.

name: The Omnichannel Loop
headline: Meet the Omnichannel Loop — your 14-day buyer recovery system
body: A circular flow that turns one webinar into 14 days of selling: Live Webinar → Replay 1 → DM Nudge → Replay 2 → Bonus Drop → Closeout.
visual: Hand-drawn loop with arrows. Each station gets a tiny icon. Friendly and human, not corporate.

name: The Math Behind The Loop
headline: Coaches running the loop close 2.3x more buyers per registrant
visual: One huge number. '2.3x' in giant typeface filling the slide. Source line in small text bottom-left.

name: Marisol's $48k Recovery
headline: One coach. Same offer. New loop. +$48k.
body: Marisol had a 90-minute webinar that did $11k. Same offer wrapped in the loop did $59k over 14 days. Nothing about the offer changed — just the system around it.
visual: Before/after revenue bars side by side. Photo of Marisol on the right. Quote from her below in italics.

name: Why I'm The One Teaching This
headline: I've built loops for 100+ coaching offers — and broken plenty too
body: Two sentences on me. One sentence on what I'm not (a guru). One sentence on why I care about getting this right.
visual: Photo of me at the whiteboard, mid-teach. Same energy as the recent FB post. Three small logo strips below: clients, podcasts, results.

name: Introducing OmnichannelOS
headline: Introducing OmnichannelOS
body: If you don't want to spend 6 months building this from scratch — we already did. Here's the system.
visual: Big logo reveal slide. Dark background. Logo lockup centered. Tagline below in muted gold.

headline: Everything you need to run the loop on day one
body:

Total value $X — your investment $Y.

name: Q&A + Claim Your Spot
headline: Drop your question in chat — and grab your spot
body: Two parallel paths: ask a question in the chat OR click the link to claim your seat. Bonus expires when this webinar ends.
visual: Split screen. Left half: 'Ask anything.' Right half: 'Claim your spot →' with a giant arrow. Countdown timer in the corner.
